body.p: This paper is presented in response to the Non-Final Office Action dated October 9, 2024 (the "Office Action"), wherein (a) claims 1-27 were pending; (b) claim 5 was objected; (c) claims 1-4, 6-7, 9-20, and 22-27 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as allegedly being anticipated by Petit et al. (U.S. Pub. No. 2023/0111436A1, hereinafter "Petit"); and (d) claims 8 and 21 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly being unpatentable over Petit, as applied to claim 1 and 19, in view of Bae et al. (U.S. Pub. No. 2017/0151883A1, hereinafter "Bae").

By the foregoing, claim 5 is canceled and claims 1, 19, 20, 24 and 27 are amended. Support for the amendments may be found variously throughout the disclosure, including at original claim 5. No new matter is added. In view of the following remarks, reconsideration and allowance are respectfully requested.
On December 12, 2024, Examiner Alizada and the undersigned engaged in a

telephonic interview. During the interview, the rejection of claims 12, 15 and 16 under 35 U.S.C. § 102 was discussed. No formal agreement was reached. Applicant thanks Examiner Alizada for their time and consideration in connection with the interview.

Claims 20 and 24 are amended to correct formailities. Claim 5 was objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Applicant hereby amends independent claim 1 to incorporate the allowable subject matter of claim 5, and similarly amends independent claims 19 and 27 to incorporate the allowable subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits the amended independent claims 1, 19, and 27, and claims 2-18 and 20-26 dependent therefrom, contain the allowable subject matter and are in condition for allowance.

Claims 1-4, 6-7, 9-20, and 22-27 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as allegedly being anticipated by Petit. Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection in light of the amendments of the independent claims which incorporate the allowable subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and removal of the rejection under 35 U.S.C. @ 102.

Claims 8 and 21 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly being unpatentable over Petit in view of Bae. Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection in light of the amendments of the independent claims which incorporate the allowable subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and removal of the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 103.
It is submitted that the Application is in condition for allowance. Should the

Examiner wish to discuss the foregoing, or any matter of form or procedure in an effort to advance this Application to allowance, the Examiner is respectfully invited to contact the undersigned attorney at the indicated telephone number set forth below.

This paper is deemed to be timely filed. However, the Director is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency in the fees filed, asserted to be filed or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Deposit Account No. 13-2855, under Order No. 32060/57721A.
